facts.text: Evan received a painting from a friend, which inspired him to start painting.

evidence.quote: It all started when a friend of mine gave me this painting one day, it inspired me a lot and that's when I started painting.

facts.text: Evan joined painting classes to find like-minded people and demonstrate his skills.

evidence.quote: And I joined the classes to find like-minded people and show them what I can do, you can always improve your skills.

facts.text: Evan is currently painting and may consider other classes in the future.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Sam! Just been painting with these for now, but might look into other classes.

facts.text: Evan finds painting to be a way to find peace and express himself.

evidence.quote: It's awesome for finding my peace and expressing myself!
